description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Deloitte is seeking a Frontend Developer to join its AI & Engineering team and help clients modernize technology platforms and drive business outcomes. The role focuses on designing data architectures, building scalable data engineering solutions, developing analytics applications, and collaborating with cross-functional teams using Palantir Foundry and cloud-based technologies.
Data platform engineer building cloud data pipelines, analytics applications, and operational workflows

Responsibilities:
• Designing modern data architecture, data pipelines, and workflows using Palantir Foundry and cloud-based technologies
• Building and deploying data engineering solutions that support enterprise transformation and mission-driven outcomes
• Developing analytics products and applications that integrate, transform, and operationalize enterprise data
• Collaborating with cross-functional teams to define requirements, resolve technical issues, and deliver scalable solutions
• Applying DevOps and statistical programming tools to improve data quality, platform performance, and operational efficiency

Requirements:
• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
• Effective written and verbal communication skills
• Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
• Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
• Ability to lead projects or workstreams
• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
• Ability to meet deadlines
• Ability to provide clear guidance to others
• Bachelor's degree
• 1+ years of experience with JavaScript or TypeScript, HTML, and CSS
• 1+ years of experience designing responsive, accessible, and user-centered interfaces with a modern frontend framework, preferably React
• Active Secret security clearance
• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:
• Palantir Foundry application development, including Workshop, the Ontology, Object Views, Actions, and Foundry APIs or SDKs
• Maven Smart System and other Palantir Foundry data-processing, visualization, or mission-application capabilities
• React and TypeScript in data-intensive, enterprise, or mission-critical environments
• Data visualization libraries or frameworks such as D3, Plotly, or comparable tools
• UI/UX design, prototyping, design systems, and accessibility standards
• REST APIs, JSON, SQL, Python, and basic data transformation workflows
• Department of Defense/War, military readiness, or federal government environments
